evidence: The copper complex used as precursor was bis [2,2,6,6,-tetramethyl-3,5-heptadionato] Cu(II), which was vapourized at 120–140 1C. Ultra-high purity (UHP, 99.999%) argon was used as the carrier gas, UHP hydrogen as the reducing (reactant) gas, and UHP nitrogen as the purge gas in the ALD process.
